prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a hit while turning left. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1193; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with reported head impact and a diagnosis of concussion. Over the course of care, the patient attended 27 visits. Management consisted of symptom monitoring, graded activity guidance, vestibular and balance assessment, and cognitive rest recommendations, with visit frequency reduced progressively as symptoms resolved, consistent with the expected recovery pattern for this condition. Several examination findings are consistent with a concussive injury, while other neurological and cognitive screening results fall within normal limits. No prior injury to the same region of the head or neck is documented in the available history. At this time, it remains unclear whether the current symptoms are entirely attributable to this event, and further clarification may be needed. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for the services rendered.
